newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Folgado sees Feb budget surplus.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Folgado sees Feb budget surplus.

text.p: Spanish Budget Secretary Jose Folgado estimated on Wednesday that there would be a government budget surplus in February after an expected deficit in January.
Folgado told reporters: "In February, preliminary estimates point to a (budget) cash surplus."
The expected January cash deficit was explained by seasonal and technical factors applicable in the year-earlier month, which would disappear in the coming months, he added.
In December alone, the cash deficit was 1,096.9 billion pesetas. -- Madrid newsroom +341 585 2160
